response.justification: Candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer but has spent nearly his entire career on web/full-stack development (Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, DLang) with only brief, dated C++ exposure (2014-2015 at National Instruments). He lacks the required 8-12 years of hands-on C++/STL, message brokers, MQTT, IEC 62443 security standards, and industrial automation background that are core to this role.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level software engineering experience across many domains
Demonstrated ability to work with low-level, high-performance systems (DLang, async I/O, fibers)
Strong communication and mentoring track record (talks, workshops, courses)
concerns: Minimal recent C++ experience (only ~6 months, over 10 years ago) and no STL/OOP C++ project history
No evidence of MQTT, REST-based IoT, message brokers, or industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850, etc.)
No mention of Secure Development Lifecycle, IEC 62443, or industrial cybersecurity practices

key_factors.factor: No industrial automation / IoT protocol or security standard exposure
Strong general software engineering seniority and architecture experience
